description: Read one of the signed-in person's site scans: whether it is still running, and once it has finished the score, the checks that failed, the category scores and the pages it covered, each page with a link to its own full report. Only the account that ran the scan can read it. A scan that is still running is normal, not an error. A full scan of a large site usually takes about 2 and a half minutes and nine in ten finish within about 5 and a half minutes; a site of ten pages or fewer usually finishes in under half a minute. Do not poll: the first answer asks for one check after 30 seconds, and if the scan is still running the next answer says how long to wait. Read check_again_after_seconds in the answer and wait that long before the next check.

job_id.description: The job_id start_site_scan returned, or one from list_sites or site_history.
